Read the statuses the client receives: change-password on a password account gives 401 (wrong current), 400 (short new), 409 (login-key fields), 200 with the new hash verifying; on a login-key account 409 (password fields), 401 (wrong current key), 400 (no rewrapped copy), 400 (1000 rounds), 200 with the new copy stored.
